files.Chart.yaml:
apiVersion: v2
name: parcel
version: 0.1.0
type: application
files.values.yaml:
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: example.invalid/parcel
  tag: "1.2"
service:
  port: 8080
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
files.templates/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "parcel.labels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "parcel.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: parcel
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}

queries.question: How does templates/service.yaml use parcel.labels from templates/_helpers.tpl?
With values-production.yaml supplied after values.yaml, which replica count overrides the default and where is it consumed?
How is service.port wired into the Service and Deployment templates?
How are the container image repository and tag combined?

files.base/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: parcel-worker
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: parcel-worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: parcel-worker
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: example.invalid/worker:1.2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: parcel-settings
files.base/service.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: parcel-worker
spec:
  selector:
    app: parcel-worker
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
files.base/configmap.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: parcel-settings
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
files.base/kustomization.yaml:
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - deployment.yaml
  - service.yaml
  - configmap.yaml
files.overlays/production/kustomization.yaml:
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: replicas.yaml
files.overlays/production/replicas.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: parcel-worker
spec:
  replicas: 3
